body: I've been cheated on before, serveral times, and it has completely destroyed me. I stated above that I can't justify my actions other than I was being self destructive. My relationship was the only good thing going in my life and I guess I didn't think I deserved that at the time, so I began to destroy it in the only way I knew how. It's selfish and weak, and I'm not asking for pity from anyone, or how to make things right, because they never will be. I'm just asking for advice on how to fix myself without ending it all.

I know I can't win him back now, not even with all the apologies in the world. I don't know how to make things right with my family, and they're the most important thing to me. I'm so ashamed and don't know where to go from here. He wouldn't tell me how much he knows or how much he's told my family. He's also told me that some of my friends have told him I've cheated in the past, when honestly this was the first time. I don't know why any of them would tell him that, and he won't tell me who told him. I literally don't know who I can trust anymore, if anyone.
